issue.title: test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member fails deterministically since @small dropped its Antigravity member
issue.description:
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member
fails deterministically on clean master HEAD 630f4ea71 (verified via `git stash` in
workspace sase_22, no local changes present, isolated rerun: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member`
-> 1 failed).

Failure: `StopIteration` at
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py:202 in
`agy_member = next(member for member in details.members if member.target == agy_target)`
where `agy_target = "agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high"` and
`details = model_alias_selector_details(SMALL_MODEL_ALIAS_NAME)`.

Root cause: commit 630f4ea71 "fix(llm-provider): restore Gemini 3.7 Flash High to
@xsmall only" (SASE_PLAN=202608/restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md, a tale plan, not an
epic) edited src/sase/llm_provider/model_alias_defaults.yml so `@small`'s target no
longer includes `agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high` (it moved exclusively to `@xsmall`). The
commit updated its own new/changed regression tests but missed this pre-existing test,
which still asserts that disabling agy on a usage-limit error removes
`agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high` from the `@small` pool.

Impact: blocks `just check`/`just check-full`'s scoped and full test lanes for every
agent regardless of diff, whenever this node is selected or the full suite runs.
Discovered while implementing the unrelated plan
sase/repos/plans/202608/finalizer_staged_bead_state.md (only touches
src/sase/bead/_sync_git.py and src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_*.py plus new/
updated tests under tests/test_bead/ and tests/llm_provider/).

Likely fix: update the test to target a small-pool member that still exists after
630f4ea71 (e.g. one of the Claude/Codex/Grok high-effort members), or repoint its
Antigravity-specific assertion at `@xsmall` instead of `@small`, matching the new
model_alias_defaults.yml topology.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during sase-n8.8 final verification on 2026-08-16: monitored 'SASE_CORE_DIR=/tmp/sase-core-absent-for-published-wheel just check-full' failed tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member with the same StopIteration looking for agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high under SMALL_MODEL_ALIAS_NAME. Focused rerun of the failed nodes reproduced this test immediately; inspecting src/sase/llm_provider/model_alias_defaults.yml shows agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high under @xsmall and @small containing only claude/codex/grok high-effort members. The local diff only restores public HistoryWordCompletionMetadata and updates its direct tests, so this is not caused by sase-n8.8.

Independent reproduction from sase-n8.land on a newer master than this bead records. Workspace sase_14, clean master 2605324cb (vs the bead's 630f4ea71), after a from-scratch 'just install'. Surfaced by 'just test-scoped' during epic sase-n8's landing verification: 2 failed, 31684 passed, 11 skipped in 341s, and this node was one of the two. Isolated rerun reproduces deterministically: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member -q -p no:randomly' -> 1 failed, same StopIteration at tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py:202 seeking target 'agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high' in model_alias_selector_details(SMALL_MODEL_ALIAS_NAME).members. Root cause as recorded (commit 630f4ea71 moving Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only) is unchanged and still stands five commits later. Impact: every agent whose diff selects this node hits it at the mandatory 'just check' gate; sase-n8's landing diff touches only Launch Control footer markup and a Justfile symvision entry, so the selection was incidental.

Independently reproduced on clean master 3a22ff04f while landing epic sase-ns: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py -q -p no:randomly -> FAILED TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member (StopIteration looking for agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high on @small after 630f4ea71 moved it to @xsmall). Deterministic, not load-dependent. Also seen by epic sase-ns phase bead sase-ns.2 in full-lane monitor w2v4hf403r64. Note for triage: in-progress epic phase sase-n4.5.4.2 ('Follow Antigravity's current xsmall-only routing') appears to be working exactly this.
